nodes.notes: One item from a deploy door: {mode, sender, execId, wfId, automation, recordId} for prepare, {mode, sender, execId, wfId, automation, state} for finish. Awaited by both callers, with the error left to travel: a sub-workflow carries no Error Logger and fails into the run that was actually doing the work.

nodes.name: Stamp Running
nodes.notes: Claims the launch row for this run on the CALLER's execution id, which is what finish upserts on. It never gates: a launch id that resolves to nothing must reach Init Deploy so the refusal is named on a row instead of crashing nameless.
